202.description: Already claimed generation pending; Retry-After1; no new attempt

503.description: Generation unavailable or failed; no automatic rebilling

200.description: Current device-scoped result; no measured acoustic evidence

post.description: Explicitly generate one authored phone-only preview. Audited 24-hour idempotency; independent concurrency of one, eight-second provider deadline, at most 16 cached results for 60 seconds. Does not mutate Show state or issue device commands.

parameters.name: X-DV-Device-Id
parameters.description: Required and equal to deviceId for an account session; never substitutes for operator authorization.

200.description: Cached preview result, including failed generation; never a device playback acknowledgement.

202.description: One already-admitted generation is pending; Retry-After: 1.

401.description: Account session or server-admin credential required.

403.description: Operate permission or matching account device scope required.

409.description: Operation identity conflicts with the original request.

410.description: Previously consumed operation has expired; no automatic provider retry.

503.description: Speech disabled, unavailable or preview lane busy.

get.description: Read an already-admitted phone-only preview. No generation or retry on GET; same operate authority as creation. No device playback ACK.

DeviceToken.description: Existing expiring device access token; server derives device scope from token.

AccountSession.name: __Host-dv-account
AccountSession.description: Authenticated account session with operate permission for the X-DV-Device-Id scope.

AccountCsrf.name: X-DV-CSRF
AccountCsrf.description: Account antiforgery token for preview creation; server-admin bearer requests use their existing boundary.

ShowState.description: Versioned projection defined by the same-named C# record; optional fields are additive.

DuelView.description: Versioned projection defined by the same-named C# record; optional fields are additive.

ChronicleSnapshot.description: Versioned projection defined by the same-named C# record; optional fields are additive.

stopRevision.description: Explicit physical Stop command revision, independent of quiet and settings.

wavBase64.description: Cached PCM16 mono 32kHz WAV, at most eight seconds; fake mode returns an explicitly synthetic silent fixture.

OperationEpoch.description: Original device operation epoch as a canonical uint64 decimal string. Absent means legacy zero; retries never adopt a newer epoch.
